experimental_method: Synthetic (isochoric P-T kink points in a sapphire-window autoclave, with molar volumes) and analytic (liquid-phase sampling, gas by volumetry at 77.3 K, water by weighing) methods.
uncertainties_stated: T 0.5 K (agreement of break points +-1 K and +-0.5% of P); P +-0.1 MPa; total volume 0.2%; molar volume +-0.3% at 673 K; analytic liquid N2 amount 1-2%, water by weighing better than 1%; synthetic-method compositions corrected for dead volume assumed filled with water.
quality_remarks: Synthetic compositions are overall fillings corrected for dead volume; analytic rows for x(H2O)>=0.93 interpolated isopleths are described as having larger uncertainty. Possible hydrate near 25 C and 200 MPa noted by authors (not in the tables, all data >=480 K). Two isopleth Tsiklis points are plotted only.
